title_transfers_guest: Transfers: send files straight to people ➤ Sendly
desc_transfers_guest: Send end-to-end encrypted files straight to other Sendly users. No links to share: they accept, then download.

transfers_guest_step_decline: Don't want it? Decline, and it's gone for good.
transfers_guest_step_accept: Accept, and it's yours. Decrypted only on your device.

desc_index: Sendly lets you send files to people or devices, fast and easy without annoying limits. Upload a file, get a link and share it with anyone.
desc_link: Upload a file on Sendly, get a shareable link and send it to anyone. Files are end-to-end encrypted and delete themselves automatically.
desc_quickshare: Share multiple files with a group in real time on Sendly. Like a shared folder, everyone can send and receive freely.
desc_shared: You got sent a file on Sendly. Download and decrypt it securely. Files are end-to-end encrypted and expire automatically.
desc_tos: Terms of Service for Sendly. Please read the conditions for using our file sharing service carefully.

desc_limits: Current file size limits, retention periods and rate limits for Sendly, for guests and logged-in users.
desc_encryption: Sendly encrypts every file end-to-end before it leaves your device. Learn how data encryption and decryption work.
desc_help: Help and FAQ for Sendly. Answers to common questions about sharing files, links, quick shares and encryption.

limits_intro: Sendly offers two tiers of service depending on whether you are logged in or accessing the service as a guest. Below are the current limits for each tier.
limits_guest_rate: Rate Limit: Dynamic, based on Server Load and Usage Patterns
limits_auth_rate: Rate Limit: Dynamic, based on Server Load and Usage Patterns. Higher allowance window
limits_auth_device: Device management: File sync between devices
limits_auth_recent: Recent uploads: Browse and re-download your file history from any device
limits_rate_intro: To ensure fair usage and prevent abuse, the following rate limits are enforced per IP address and Session:
limits_rate_restricted: Restricted: No requests allowed (Special Cases or Violations)
limits_rate_note: These limits are deliberately conservative during development and can be adjusted dynamically and automatically.
limits_expiry_text: All uploaded files are automatically deleted from our servers after their retention period expires. We do not retain copies of expired files. The expiration timer starts at the moment the file upload is finalized.
limits_contact_text: If you need higher limits or have questions about these restrictions, please contact us at
